args.prompt: The man keeps his exact identity: long pale face, heavy dark brows, swept-back hair with silver temples, ENORMOUS charcoal-black waxed handlebar moustache with big spiral tips that completely covers his mouth (mouth never visible, eyes never wide), black turtleneck, charcoal blazer, oxblood pocket square, brass viewfinder.
